title: What if I ask in alia lingua? Measuring Functional Similarity Across Languages
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates large language models across different domains including 'ethics', 'morality', 'philosophy', and 'world religions' (see Section 4.1, RQ2, and Tables 5-6). It hypothesizes and analyzes how cross-lingual consistency varies specifically in these culturally sensitive and moral/ethical subjects compared to STEM subjects.
